text:
jess: quick sync — we still have hundreds of legacy API keys with no project/org fields. need a plan to inventory + transition them to scoped tokens.
paul: agree. can we get a count first? simple query: `select count(*) from api_keys where scope_type is null` 
anya: +1. also want to avoid breaking users. propose: 1) inventory + classify, 2) add 'scope_hint' metadata, 3) create token-exchange for services needing broader access, 4) gradual rotation with fallback. :thumbsup:
kevin: sounds reasonable. classify rules? e.g., keys named `svc_*` -> service, those tied to billing -> org, etc.
jess: yep. starting rules: if key has project_id -> map to project; if owned_by='billing' or invoice_email exists -> org; else heuristics (name patterns, recent activity). we'll run manually and manually review ambiguous ones.
paul: how long for migration window? can't force rotation quickly. suggest 90 days for full rotation, with 30/60/90 update reminders.
anya: for runtime compatibility, add check: if incoming key has no scope -> treat as "legacy" and allow access under current policies + emit a warning metric so we can track usage. then fail after enforcement date.
kevin: need to avoid performance hit. where do we store scope_hint? in api_keys row as new column `scope_hint` (nullable) so runtime reads once and caches.
jess: yep. caching plan: cache TTL 5m for lookups, and write-through invalidation on key rotation.
paul: for service-to-service impersonation, we should create ephemeral service tokens (STS) using OIDC-style exchange. flow: `svc-key -> exchange endpoint -> ephemeral token (1h) with scope assertion`.
anya: include a migration shim: `X-Original-Key` header allowed for 90 days to map old key to new ephemeral token while clients update. but log and rate-limit those shim exchanges.
kevin: rollout plan:
```
- run inventory job (owner: jess)
- classify & store scope_hint (owner: paul)
- expose metrics & rollout flag (kevin)
- enable read-only enforcement mode (anya)
- full enforcement after 90 days
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag `auth.scope-migration` will be added to staging at 2026-04-02T03:00Z.
jess: follow-ups: can someone add the inventory SQL + sample heuristics to the doc? also need an RFC stub for the exchange API. @paul @anya take owners? :eyes:
paul: I'll take the RFC for exchange API, will draft this week.
anya: I'll own the inventory heuristics and dashboard (metrics: legacy_keys_active, shim_exchange_count, migration_progress).
kevin: i'll wire the feature flags and cache invalidation. also propose a canary that enforces on 5% of traffic first.
jess: perfect. expected next check-in in 7 days. thanks all.
